name: DungeonFlagstone
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.488

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven stone_tiles_02 (large irregular split slabs with mortared joints), darkened to the original dungeon floor grey, with foot-polished slab tops along walked lines and dark grit packed in the joints. Floor only: irregular slabs, no courses
known_weaknesses: single scan at 2 m; slabs are 25-45 cm, smaller than a great-hall flag
